mappingNote: North up, RA increasing to the left, RA 0h at the horizontal centre. Measured, not assumed - see registration below.
source: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio - Deep Star Maps (SVS 3895), starmap_8k.jpg
rights: NASA SVS imagery is not copyrighted. Credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio.
content: Plotted from the Bright Star, Tycho-2 and UCAC3 catalogs (~100 million stars). The Milky Way band is real integrated starlight, not an artistic rendering.
limitations: Stars within about 20 degrees of the celestial poles are smeared horizontally by the projection, an artefact of the source map.

registration.method: High-pass filtered image, matched filter against HYG stars brighter than magnitude 4 over all axis flips and pixel offsets.
